title: CameraService Wakeup Troubleshooting
content: CameraService may fail to initialize during vehicle wakeup. Check CAN communication and camera initialization timing. Known solution is to use the updated initialization sequence introduced in Camera Stack 4.2.3.

title: CAN Gateway Startup Problems
content: CAN gateway communication problems after ECU restart can be caused by incorrect startup ordering. Updated gateway software contains the corrected initialization sequence.

title: Brake ECU Diagnostic Timeout Guide
content: For brake ECU diagnostic timeouts, verify ECU load and diagnostic session timing. Increase the diagnostic timeout when the ECU is still processing startup requests.

title: ADAS Camera Calibration Deployment Checklist
content: ADAS camera calibration data must be included in the deployment artifact. Verify calibration package presence before running camera calibration tests.

title: Lane Detection Stream Recovery
content: If lane detection stops after a perception processor restart, verify that the perception service reconnects to the camera stream.

title: Lidar Cold Boot Initialization
content: Lidar initialization can remain pending if readiness events are consumed before the service subscribes. Check startup event ordering.

title: Lidar Streaming and Buffer Tuning
content: Long-duration lidar tests should monitor point-cloud buffer usage. Buffer exhaustion can interrupt the stream.

title: Radar Resume Handling
content: After system resume, verify that the radar heartbeat timer is restarted and periodic messages are restored.

title: Radar Object Cache Handling
content: Radar object caches should be cleared when an empty sensor frame is received to prevent stale objects from being displayed.

title: Infotainment Display Boot Dependencies
content: The graphics driver must be ready before the display compositor starts. Incorrect startup ordering can result in a black display.

title: Touchscreen Resume Troubleshooting
content: If touch input is unavailable after resume, verify input-device registration and resume handling.

title: GPS Startup Acquisition
content: GPS receiver configuration should be applied after hardware readiness. Position acquisition may require retries after startup.

title: GPS Time Synchronization
content: Synchronize system time only after a valid GPS fix is available. Retry synchronization if the receiver has not acquired satellites.

title: Battery Status Wakeup
content: Battery status signals may remain stale after wakeup if subscriptions are not restored. Verify signal registration during network recovery.

title: Battery State of Charge Polling
content: Verify the battery status polling interval when state-of-charge updates are delayed after ignition.

title: Thermal Fan State Machine
content: Cooling fan commands should be accepted only in valid controller states. Incorrect transitions can cause commands to be ignored.

title: Temperature Sensor Polling
content: Keep temperature sensor polling independent from long-running diagnostic operations to avoid stale sensor values.

title: Door Status Event Ordering
content: Door status events should be published after the body controller confirms the requested state transition.

title: Door ECU Sleep Coordination
content: Door ECUs should enter sleep only after network-manager synchronization has completed. Incorrect ordering may cause communication loss.

title: Lighting Command Prioritization
content: Lighting commands can be delayed during vehicle state transitions. Check command queue priority when response latency increases.

title: High Beam State Validation
content: Use event sequence validation for lighting state updates when duplicate or out-of-order messages are observed.

title: HVAC Wakeup Sequence
content: HVAC communication channels should be initialized only after the vehicle network is ready following wakeup.

title: HVAC Temperature Persistence
content: Persist cabin temperature targets in non-volatile configuration when the target must survive a power cycle.

title: Audio Service Startup Dependencies
content: Audio service startup requires the audio hardware service to be available first. Verify service dependency ordering.

title: Bluetooth Audio Reconnection
content: After Bluetooth transport reconnect, recreate the audio session before resuming playback.

title: Bluetooth Pairing at Startup
content: Pairing requests received during Bluetooth stack startup should be queued until required profiles are ready.

title: Bluetooth Sleep Resume
content: Reload the pairing database when the Bluetooth service resumes after vehicle sleep.

title: USB Enumeration During Boot
content: USB storage devices connected during startup may require enumeration retries after the storage controller becomes ready.

title: USB Large Transfer Troubleshooting
content: For intermittent large-file transfer failures, inspect transfer timeout and retry configuration.

title: Security Token Time Validation
content: Secure-token validation should refresh trusted time after significant system clock adjustments.

title: Certificate Renewal Scheduling
content: Certificate renewal scheduling should use UTC timestamps consistently to avoid missed renewal windows.

title: OTA Resumable Downloads
content: OTA downloads should resume after temporary network changes rather than restarting from the beginning.

title: OTA Package Integrity Validation
content: Verify package checksum encoding and compare calculated checksums with the release manifest.

title: ECU Startup Dependency Troubleshooting
content: When multiple ECUs fail during startup, inspect dependency ordering and readiness events before investigating individual application errors.

title: Network Wakeup Diagnostic Checklist
content: For wakeup-related communication failures, check network manager state, ECU readiness, message timing and service initialization order.
